workday.name: get_worker
workday.description: Get the current Workday worker profile. Result is rendered as an interactive widget.

workday.name: get_leave_balances
workday.description: Retrieve leave balances and eligible absence types for the current worker. The response includes eligibleAbsenceTypes[].id -- use this ID as timeOffTypeId when calling prepare_request_leave.

workday.name: get_direct_reports
workday.description: List direct reports for the current worker.

workday.name: get_inbox_tasks
workday.description: List Workday inbox tasks for the current worker. Result is rendered as an interactive widget with inline approve/deny.

workday.name: get_learning_assignments
workday.description: Retrieve required learning assignments. Result is rendered as an interactive widget.

workday.name: get_pay_slips
workday.description: List recent Workday pay slips.

workday.name: get_time_off_entries
workday.description: List time off entries for the current worker.

workday.name: prepare_request_leave
workday.description: Book time off — opens the interactive leave booking form for the user to review and confirm. Use this when the user asks to book leave, request PTO, or take time off. Pass startDate, endDate, quantity, unit, and timeOffTypeId (from get_leave_balances). The user confirms and submi

workday.name: book_leave
workday.description: Submit leave request to Workday. Widget callback — called automatically by the leave booking form after the user clicks Submit. To book leave, use prepare_request_leave instead.

workday.name: prepare_change_business_title
workday.description: Change business title — opens the interactive title change form for the user to enter a new title and submit. Use this when the user asks to change their business title.

workday.name: change_business_title
workday.description: Submit business title change to Workday. Widget callback — called automatically by the title change form after the user clicks Submit. To change a business title, use prepare_change_business_title instead.

workday.name: search_learning_content
workday.description: Search Workday learning content filtered by skills and/or category. Accepts optional 'category' (e.g. 'Cloud Computing') to narrow available skills and optional 'skills' list. Resolves names to Workday IDs automatically; invalid values are dropped.

workday.name: get_org_chart
workday.description: Get the organizational chart for the current worker's supervisory organization.

workday.name: get_team_calendar
workday.description: Get the team time-off calendar showing who is out in the current worker's team.

workday.name: get_team_overview
workday.description: Get a team overview dashboard for managers showing headcount, role breakdown, and team member details.

workday.name: get_team_performance_summary
workday.description: Get team performance review status for managers including pending inbox items and team absence overview.

workday.name: action_inbox_task
workday.description: Approve or reject a Workday inbox task. Provide the task_id from get_inbox_tasks and decision ('approve' or 'deny'). Optionally include a comment.

workday.name: get_inbox_task_detail
workday.description: Get detailed information about a specific Workday inbox task by its task_id.

workday.name: get_goals
workday.description: Get your performance goals including status, due dates, and categories. Result is rendered as an interactive dashboard.

workday.name: get_feedback
workday.description: Get anytime feedback you've received from colleagues and managers.

workday.name: give_feedback
workday.description: Give anytime feedback to a colleague. Provide worker_id, comment, and optional badge ID (from get_feedback_badges).

workday.name: get_feedback_badges
workday.description: List available feedback badges that can be used when giving anytime feedback.

workday.name: get_development_items
workday.description: Get your individual development plan items including skills, dates, and status. Result is rendered as an interactive widget.

workday.name: request_feedback_on_self
workday.description: Request feedback on yourself from peers and managers. Optionally include a message.

workday.name: get_learning_records
workday.description: Get your learning history with completion status, grades, scores, and expiration dates.

workday.name: get_check_ins
workday.description: Get 1:1 check-in records with topics and notes.

workday.name: create_check_in
workday.description: Create a 1:1 check-in record. Provide description, date, participant_id, and optional topic_ids.

workday.name: get_check_in_topics
workday.description: List check-in topics available for creating check-ins.

workday.name: get_worker_skills
workday.description: Get skills listed on your Workday profile.

workday.name: get_team_goals
workday.description: Get performance goals for all direct reports showing goal status and due dates (manager tool). Result is rendered as an interactive widget.

workday.name: request_feedback_on_worker
workday.description: Request feedback on a specific direct report. Provide worker_id and optional comment (manager tool).

workday.name: prepare_give_feedback
workday.description: Open the give feedback widget — select a colleague, pick a badge, and write feedback. Use when the user wants to recognize or give feedback to someone.

workday.name: prepare_create_check_in
workday.description: Open the check-in creation widget — select a team member, choose topics, set a date, and create a 1:1 check-in. Use when a manager wants to schedule or create a check-in.

workday.name: get_job_profiles
workday.description: List Workday job profiles with optional search filter. Use to find the right job profile for a hire.

workday.name: get_job_profile
workday.description: Get details of a single Workday job profile by ID including job family and management level.

workday.name: get_job_families
workday.description: List Workday job families with optional search filter. Job families group related job profiles.

workday.name: get_jobs
workday.description: List Workday jobs (filled positions) with optional search filter.

workday.name: get_job_requisitions
workday.description: List open job requisitions. Use to find requisitions available for hiring into.

workday.name: get_supervisory_orgs
workday.description: List supervisory organizations with optional search filter. Use to find the target org for a hire.

workday.name: get_supervisory_org_members
workday.description: List members of a supervisory organization by org_id. Use to review current team composition or find internal candidates.

workday.name: get_job_change_reasons
workday.description: List valid job change reasons (e.g. New Hire, Promotion, Transfer). Use to get a reason_id for create_job_change.

workday.name: create_job_change
workday.description: Initiate a job change for a worker (hire, promote, or transfer). Provide worker_id and reason_id (from get_job_change_reasons). Optionally provide job_profile_id, supervisory_org_id, position_id, or job_requisition_id. Returns a job change event ID for submit_job_change.

workday.name: get_job_change
workday.description: Get details and status of a job change event by its ID.

workday.name: submit_job_change
workday.description: Submit a job change event for approval. Provide the job_change_id from create_job_change.

workday.name: create_org_assignment_change
workday.description: Initiate an organization assignment change for a worker. Assign company, cost center, region, or business unit. Returns a change ID for submit_org_assignment_change.

workday.name: submit_org_assignment_change
workday.description: Submit an organization assignment change for approval. Provide the change_id from create_org_assignment_change.

servicenow.name: list_incidents
servicenow.description: Search and list ServiceNow incidents. Supports filtering by free-text search, incident number, category, state, priority, assigned user, and active status. Returns up to 100 incidents per call. Results are rendered as an interactive widget.

servicenow.name: show_create_incident_form
servicenow.description: Create a new incident — opens the interactive creation form for the user to fill in and submit. Use this when the user asks to report an issue, create an incident, or log a problem. Pass any known details to pre-fill fields including assignment_group for intelligent routing.

servicenow.name: create_incident
servicenow.description: Submit incident creation to ServiceNow. Widget callback — called automatically by the incident form after the user clicks Submit. To create an incident, use show_create_incident_form instead.

servicenow.name: show_update_incident_form
servicenow.description: Edit an existing incident — fetches the incident and opens the interactive update form with current values. Use this when the user asks to update or edit an incident. Provide the incident number (e.g. INC0010006).

servicenow.name: get_incident
servicenow.description: Retrieve full details and comment/work-note history for a single ServiceNow incident by its number (e.g. INC0010006). Use this to show the user an incident's current state and conversation history.

servicenow.name: update_incident
servicenow.description: Submit incident updates to ServiceNow. Widget callback — called automatically by the incident update form after the user clicks Submit. To update an incident, use show_update_incident_form instead.

servicenow.name: list_tasks
servicenow.description: List active ServiceNow tasks. Queries the task table which spans all task-derived tables (incidents, changes, problems, etc.). Returns active tasks ordered by most recently updated.

servicenow.name: update_task
servicenow.description: Update a ServiceNow task. Change state, priority, assignment, or add comments/work notes. Only the sys_id is required -- include only the fields you want to change.

servicenow.name: list_approvals
servicenow.description: List pending ServiceNow approvals from the sysapproval_approver table. Returns approvals in 'requested' state, ordered by most recently created.

servicenow.name: get_approval
servicenow.description: Get full details of a single ServiceNow approval by its sys_id. Returns approver, state, source table, document information, and comments.

servicenow.name: approve_reject
servicenow.description: Approve or reject a ServiceNow approval request. Provide the sys_id and decision (approve/reject). Also used as a widget callback by the approval-review widget.

servicenow.name: list_catalog_items
servicenow.description: Search and list items from the ServiceNow Service Catalog. When a search term is provided, uses the Table API with server-side LIKE filtering on name and short_description -- faster and more complete than a page-then-filter approach. Supports filtering by category_sys_id or catal

servicenow.name: list_catalog_categories
servicenow.description: List categories in the ServiceNow Service Catalog. Use this to help the user explore the catalog structure and find the right category before listing items.

servicenow.name: get_catalog_item
servicenow.description: Get full details of a ServiceNow catalog item including its dynamic order form (variables, choices, UI policies). Renders an interactive widget where the user can fill in the form, select a quantity, and order or add to cart.

servicenow.name: order_catalog_item
servicenow.description: Submit a catalog item order to ServiceNow. Widget callback — called automatically by the catalog item widget when the user clicks Order Now. To order an item, use get_catalog_item to display it first.

servicenow.name: add_to_cart
servicenow.description: Add a catalog item to the ServiceNow shopping cart. Widget callback — called automatically by the catalog item widget when the user clicks Add to Cart. To browse items, use get_catalog_item.

servicenow.name: get_cart
servicenow.description: Get the contents of the current ServiceNow shopping cart, including item names, quantities, prices, and subtotal.

servicenow.name: checkout_cart
servicenow.description: Submit the ServiceNow shopping cart as an order. Widget callback — called automatically by the cart widget. To view the cart, use get_cart.

servicenow.name: delete_cart
servicenow.description: Empty the ServiceNow shopping cart. Widget callback — called by the cart widget, or directly to clear the cart.

servicenow.name: remove_cart_item
servicenow.description: Remove a single line item from the ServiceNow shopping cart by cart_item_id. Use get_cart first to discover cart_item_id values.

servicenow.name: list_my_requests
servicenow.description: List the current user's ServiceNow service requests (REQ) and requested items (RITM) with their catalog item name, state, stage, quantity, price, and dates. Use this when the user asks what they have on order, the status of their requests, or wants to track submitted catalog orde

servicenow.name: search_reference_values
servicenow.description: Search a ServiceNow table for reference field values. Used to look up values for reference-type catalog variables where choices come from a table (e.g. cmdb_ci, sys_user). Returns matching records with sys_id and display value.

servicenow.name: list_change_requests
servicenow.description: Search and list ServiceNow change requests. Supports filtering by free-text search, state, risk level, category, and assigned user. Returns up to 100 change requests per call.

servicenow.name: get_change_request
servicenow.description: Retrieve full details of a single ServiceNow change request by its sys_id.

servicenow.name: show_create_change_req_form
servicenow.description: Create a new change request — opens the interactive creation form for the user to fill in and submit. Use this when the user asks to create or raise a change request. Pass any known details to pre-fill fields.

servicenow.name: create_change_request
servicenow.description: Submit change request creation to ServiceNow. Widget callback — called automatically by the change request form after the user clicks Submit. To create a change request, use show_create_change_req_form instead.

servicenow.name: update_change_request
servicenow.description: Update an existing ServiceNow change request. Only the sys_id is required; include only the fields you want to change.

servicenow.name: search_knowledge
servicenow.description: Search the ServiceNow knowledge base for published articles. Supports free-text search across article titles and body text, and optional category filtering.

servicenow.name: get_knowledge_article
servicenow.description: Retrieve a single ServiceNow knowledge article by its sys_id. Returns the full article text, category, author, and publish status.

servicenow.name: list_problems
servicenow.description: Search and list ServiceNow problem records. Supports filtering by free-text search, state, priority, category, and assigned user. Returns up to 100 problems per call.

servicenow.name: show_create_problem_form
servicenow.description: Create a new problem record — opens the interactive creation form for the user to fill in and submit. Use this when the user asks to create a problem or log a root cause analysis. Pass any known details to pre-fill fields.

servicenow.name: create_problem
servicenow.description: Submit problem creation to ServiceNow. Widget callback — called automatically by the problem form after the user clicks Submit. To create a problem, use show_create_problem_form instead.

servicenow.name: update_problem
servicenow.description: Update an existing ServiceNow problem record. Only the sys_id is required; include only the fields you want to change.

servicenow.name: get_cmdb_ci
servicenow.description: Retrieve a CMDB configuration item by its sys_id. Returns name, class, category, operational status, and assignment details.

servicenow.name: list_cmdb_cis
servicenow.description: Search CMDB configuration items. Supports free-text search across name and description, and filtering by CI class, category, and operational status.

servicenow.name: get_team_incidents
servicenow.description: Team incident workload dashboard for managers. Queries active incidents assigned to team members, with breakdowns by priority, state, and assignee. Optionally filter by assignment group name. Returns the top 10 most recent incidents.

servicenow.name: get_team_approvals
servicenow.description: Bulk team approvals view for managers. Lists all pending approvals (state=requested), grouped by source table type, with approval age in hours. Returns structured data suitable for batch approve or reject decisions.

servicenow.name: get_sla_status
servicenow.description: Get SLA compliance status for incidents. Shows breached, at-risk, and compliant SLAs with percentage complete and time remaining. Optionally filter by incident number or show only breached SLAs.

servicenow.name: create_knowledge_article
servicenow.description: Create a new knowledge base article in ServiceNow as a draft. Provide title, body content, and optionally a knowledge base and category.

coupa.name: close_purchase_order

coupa.name: update_requisition

coupa.name: order_catalog_item

coupa.name: get_supplier
